Directly initialize `stringIndexes` in the member-initializer list instead of default-constructing it and conditionally assigning, removing a branch and an assignment. This is faster because the vector copy is constructed in place.

```cpp

    : values(field.values), stringIndexes(field.stringIndexes)
{
}
```
